prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: image 1, the single generated armored Mass Effect 3 Brute. Supporting canonical reference: image 2, the BioWare in-engine Brute turnaround.
Make ONE targeted correction: restore the low, deeply hunched posture and compact body proportions from image 2. Image 1 stands too upright and has legs that read too long. Lean the massive torso forward, round the huge shoulders, lower the small plated head to approximately the shoulder level, and shorten the apparent legs by matching the original model's bent knees and low hip placement. Keep the arched spine fan, heavy shoulder mass and small elongated head in their exact reference relationship. Keep the creature facing screen-right and keep the gigantic integrated pincer on its ANATOMICAL RIGHT arm, clearly visible toward the viewer. Its smaller opposite hand and both feet must remain visible.
Preserve everything else from image 1: character identity, existing armor design and all panel seams, grey metal material, brown-purple skin, dark cables, blue mechanical implants, claws, worn textures and neutral studio illumination. Use the turnaround to correct proportions and posture only; do not redesign or add details.
One full-body static creature, no opponent or violent action. Leave generous transparent space around the complete back spines, pincer and feet. Genuine transparent background, no scenery, floor, shadows, glow haze, typography, logos, model-sheet grid or second figure. The result should match the original ME3 model's strongly stooped silhouette as closely as possible.
